items.title: Unit 2 · Story
items.scene: On ___, they drive their truck to the park.
items.prompt: Listen and choose the word.
items.spokenScene: On Friday, they drive their truck to the park.
items.storyText: The green frogs live in a big tree. On Friday, they drive their truck to the park. They bring a lot of food and plates. Some frogs drum, and some frogs swim. They hop in the grass and play on the slide. On Saturday, all the frogs sleep late!
items.why: In “Happy Frogs”, you hear: On Friday, they drive their truck to the park. The missing word is “Friday”.
items.hint: Listen to this sentence again. Look at the story picture.
items.sourceLabel: Oxford Phonics World 4, Unit 2, p.19 · Titi narration of the supplied textbook text
